title: Reunion (variation I)
author: Gene Hubert
problems: The progression after row 1 "left diagonal robins chain (to new neighbor)" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 2 "robins chain (to trail buddy)" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 3 "robins start a full hey - rights in center, lefts on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers in the middle of a hey must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 4 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
Row 4 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 5 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
The progression after row 6 "slice left and straight back in long lines" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 1 "left diagonal robins chain (to new neighbor)" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the left diagonal.
Row 6 "slice left and straight back in long lines" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2 (couple 2) must stand on a side line facing across.
choices: Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
